title: eludite.forge.issues output
description: One page of issues, newest first.

items.description: An issue (a work item on Azure DevOps).

number.description: The pull request's or issue's number on the forge (GitHub's and Forgejo's number, GitLab's `iid`, Azure DevOps' pull request or work item id). Tangled has no numbers: use `id`.

id.description: The forge's own id of the item, as a string: the number again on GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Forgejo and Gitea; the record's AT-URI (`at://did:.../sh.tangled.repo.pull/<rkey>`) on Tangled.

type.description: Azure DevOps: the work item type (Bug, Task, User Story, Product Backlog Item, Issue, as the project's process names them).

author.description: A user's login (user name) on the forge; on Tangled their handle, else their DID.

items.description: A user's login (user name) on the forge; on Tangled their handle, else their DID.
A label's name (a tag on Azure DevOps).

stale.description: The answer came from the cache on disk (`.eludite/forge/`) because a refresh is still running or failed; `age_seconds` says how old it is. A read answers from the cache at once and refreshes off the UI thread.

age_seconds.description: How long ago the forge sent this answer.

refresh_error.description: Why a refresh failed; the cached answer is kept.

kind.description: Why: `rate_limited` (with `reset_at`), `network` (offline, timeout, refused), `sign_in_required` (no token stored for the host, or the forge refused it: sign in again), `forbidden` (the account may not), `not_found`, `unsupported` (the forge lacks it), `conflict`, `invalid` (the forge refused the input), `canceled`.
